findings.details: [P1] Authenticate an established vault's key before writing any new value revision. write() accepts any owner-only 32-byte key and encrypts without validating that it unlocks this vault. Independent reproduction: create revision 1, replace the key with another valid-length owner-only key, observe locked reads, replace the variable with expectedRevision 1; mutation succeeds as revision/valueRevision 2 and changes protected state. Restoring the original key leaves the current revision locked. This splits retained revisions across incompatible keys and violates D1/AC3 plus documented recovery behavior. Reject wrong-key writes without altering metadata, counters or ciphertext, using an authenticated vault identity/sentinel that remains available even when value records are deleted. Proof: /tmp/interlock-variables-fresh-review-proof.json.

[P1] Validate resolved environment values before passing Secrets to spawn and emit a safe target-specific error. A Secret containing NUL is accepted into the library and delivered to executeScript; Node rejects it with a diagnostic quoting the entire value as an escaped string. redact.text does not match Node's backslash-x00 representation. Independent valid control completes with [REDACTED], while the NUL negative persists escaped plaintext in run.error, execution.error, node.failed events and engine.inspect. This violates AC4 target validation and AC7/D3 no-value diagnostics. Cover Script and Script polling checks and avoid propagating native diagnostics containing submitted values. Proof and replay: /tmp/interlock-review-nul-secret.json and /tmp/interlock-review-nul-secret.mts.
